recommendation.verdict: Switch to BahnCard 25 saves €725 per year annually
recommendation.summaryText: Switching to the BahnCard 25 (2nd Klasse, annual) reduces your total mobility cost to €2,830.70, saving €725.21 per year compared with doing nothing. It also cuts CO₂ emissions by about 276 kg annually.
reasoning: The BahnCard 25 discount lowers ticket prices enough to offset any extra travel time.
Total annual cost drops from €3,555.91 to €2,830.70, a clear €725.21 saving.
CO₂ emissions decrease by ~20 % (275.9 kg) due to higher rail usage.
assumptions: CO2 impact is 0 for any change that only adjusts price or tier on a mode you already use (e.g. BahnCard 50 → BahnCard 25) — it only changes when an action adds or removes your only means of accessing a transport mode, such as a car-sharing membership.
